about: Policy rules P8 and P12 (milestone 0014 Story 02.0 Task 03; ADR 0005 D6/D9). The only jobs that may hold a publish-capable permission (contents: write, pull-requests: write, id-token: write, packages: write) or read a secret: 'jobs' are publish-stage jobs in stage-publish.yml, per permission class and tier; 'callers' are the jobs that call stage-publish.yml. Each entry: file, job, tier (release or staging), permission_class (jobs only: repo-write, oidc, token-only), permissions. Milestone 0012 Story 04.0 Task 02 adds the GitHub Release sequence: release-draft and release-promote (repo-write, contents: write only - no pull-requests: write, threat model 2026-11-18 RP-9) and their ci.yml caller publish-release.
